description: Source code for HTTP authentication handling in Chromium, including challenge selection, response handling, and utility functions related to HTTP auth schemes and headers.

classes.name: HttpAuth::Identity
classes.description: Represents an identity used in HTTP authentication.

methods.name: HttpAuth::ChooseBestChallenge
methods.description: Selects the best authentication challenge from response headers based on handler scores.

methods.name: HttpAuth::HandleChallengeResponse
methods.description: Handles the server's challenge response and determines authorization result.

methods.name: HttpAuth::GetChallengeHeaderName
methods.description: Returns the header name for challenges based on target (Proxy or Server).

methods.name: HttpAuth::GetAuthorizationHeaderName
methods.description: Returns the header name for authorization based on target.

methods.name: HttpAuth::GetAuthTargetString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the target (proxy or server).

methods.name: HttpAuth::SchemeToString
methods.description: Converts an auth scheme enum to its string representation.

methods.name: HttpAuth::StringToScheme
methods.description: Parses a string to its corresponding auth scheme enum.

methods.name: HttpAuth::AuthorizationResultToString
methods.description: Converts an authorization result enum to its string representation.

methods.name: HttpAuth::NetLogAuthorizationResultParams
methods.description: Creates a log dictionary entry for authorization result.
